---
name: Task for the factory
about: A change clear enough for an agent to build without guessing
---

## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and where (files, screens, commands).

## What to build

The change, in plain words. Name anything it must not touch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A check that shows it works (a test that fails today and passes after).
- [ ] …
- [ ] Existing tests change only as `## Tests that change` says, or not at all; the repo's checks pass.

## Tests that change

Optional. One bullet per existing test file this change has to change or delete: the path in backticks, then what changes or why it goes. Listed files do not make the pull request a draft.

- `test/example.test.mjs`: the error message test expects the new wording.

## Out of scope

What this issue does not cover, so the agent does not do it.
